headline: COURTROOM 🍿 ERUPTS 😱 After TUPAC 🕶️ MURDER 🚔 VERDICT Drops

The FINAL 🏁 moments inside that COURTROOM 🏛️ saw pure EMOTION 😢 erupt once the GUILTY 🦹‍♂️ verdict was OFFICIALLY 📜 entered against DUANE 🧔 "KEFFE 🅳" DAVIS for murdering TUPAC 🕶️ SHAKUR back in NINETY 🕘 SIX 6️⃣ after the JURY 🤝 needed only TWO 2️⃣ hours 🕒 to reach its DECISION 🧠!!
